name: What makes a luxury custom home builder different from a general contractor?

mainEntity.name: How is a luxury custom home builder different from a standard general contractor?
mainEntity.text: How is a luxury custom home builder different from a standard general contractor?

acceptedAnswer.text: The main difference is the level of complexity the team can manage. A luxury custom home builder should be comfortable with architect-driven design, specialty materials, detailed finish coordination, and the procurement challenges that come with high-end homes. They also need experience handling custom budgets, allowance planning, and owner decisions without losing control of the schedule. A standard general contractor may be excellent at conventional work but less prepared for the number of coordination points in a luxury home. When evaluating a builder, homeowners should look at similar projects, not just years in business. The most useful question is whether the team has completed homes with the same scale, finish level, and site conditions as the one being planned.
acceptedAnswer.description: A luxury custom home builder usually brings more experience with high-detail design coordination, premium finishes, complex sites, and owner customization. The difference is less about title and more about whether the team can manage high-end specifications, schedules, and budgets well.
